attributes.board_name: Kansas State Board of Healing Arts

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 Category I (lectures, panels, workshops, seminars, symposia, other structured formal learning), at least 1 Category III, rest Category II (consultations, quality review, teaching, journal clubs, database use, self-instruction). 1 credit = 50 minutes; 1 year of postgraduate training = 50 Category I; postbaccalaureate degree = 25 Category I
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first license renewal.
rules.alternatives: Alternative windows: 100 credits (40 Cat I, 2 Cat III) in 30 months, or 150 credits (60 Cat I, 3 Cat III) in 42 months before expiry. Extension for undue hardship (illness, injury) in the last 12 months.

topics.who: All licensees: at least 1 Category III credit (internet or live) in acute/chronic pain management, appropriate opioid prescribing, or use of prescription drug monitoring programs

rules.notes: Licenses renew annually; MD licenses expire June 30 (online renewal May 15 - July 31, late from July 1). Certification on the renewal form covers the 18 months before expiry. Board partners with CE Broker for optional tracking.
